name: Moose
appearance: An unusually tall, heavy-bodied deer with wide, palmed antlers and a long muzzle.

Trait.name: Forest Walker
Trait.effectNote: The moose has advantage on DEX (Stealth) checks in forest terrain.

Action.name: Hooves
Action.effectNote: If it moves at least 10 ft. straight toward a Large or smaller creature immediately before hitting it, the hit deals an extra 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage and knocks the target prone.

Reaction.name: Fury
Reaction.effectNote: Taking at least 5 damage gives the moose advantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn.

notes: Black Flag fixed values are Perception 13 and Stealth 10. Ability modifiers are STR +4, DEX +0, CON +2, INT −4, WIS +1 and CHA −3. No languages or special senses.
The Northlanders also call this animal Elg. The book describes it as nearly 7 ft. at the shoulder.
Source: Kobold Press, Northlands Worldbook (2026, Tales of the Valiant), p. 264.

name: Reindeer
appearance: A large deer with a pale winter coat where the brown fur has shed.

Trait.name: Agile
Trait.effectNote: The reindeer can leave an enemy’s reach without provoking an opportunity attack.

Trait.name: Snowstrider
Trait.effectNote: Snow and ice do not count as difficult terrain for the reindeer.

Bonus action.name: Burst of Speed (3/day)
Bonus action.effectNote: Its speed doubles until the start of its next turn.

notes: Black Flag fixed values are Perception 13 and Stealth 13. Ability modifiers are STR +2, DEX +3, CON +2, INT −4, WIS +1 and CHA −3. No languages or special senses.
The page extraction gives Hooves damage as 7 (1d8 + 2). The dice average 6 when rounded down. The profile records both values from the extraction.
The book gives CR 1/4. The publisher’s creature index rounds that value to 0.3.
Wild reindeer travel in herds. People across the Northlands raise domesticated reindeer for sled work, meat and milk.
Source: Kobold Press, Northlands Worldbook (2026, Tales of the Valiant), p. 264.

name: Sea Serpent
appearance: An enormous eel-like serpent with blue-green scales, a white belly, sail-like dorsal fins, a bony head ridge and four fangs.

Trait.name: Constrictor
Trait.effectNote: After a Bite hit, it can use Constrict as a bonus action.

Action.name: Constrict
Action.effectNote: One visible Huge or smaller creature within 10 ft. makes a DC 14 STR save. On a failure it takes 10 (4d4) bludgeoning damage and is grappled. The escape DC is 16.

notes: Black Flag fixed values are Perception 13 and Stealth 15. Ability modifiers are STR +6, DEX +3, CON +3, INT −4, WIS +1 and CHA −3. No languages or special senses.
Wild serpents hunt in northern waters. Those raised from eggs can imprint on an owner and serve as mounts or ship guards.
Source: Kobold Press, Northlands Worldbook (2026, Tales of the Valiant), p. 264.
